Introduction

XONIK is a four-member boy group under NATURE SPACE. The group made their debut in June 16, 2025 with the digital single "Private".

XONIK was officially introduced to the public on May 13, 2025, with the launch of their official social media accounts. The members are Leejun, Hyojin, Yeung, and Juchan. That same day, they made their first public appearance by performing their original track “Private” at the Seoul University festival. Prior to forming XONIK, Hyojin and Yeung promoted as a project duo called SUPERX, which eventually expanded into the full group.

The name XONIK (pronounced like sonic) represents sound in its most powerful form, reflecting the group’s dynamic energy and musical ambition.

Member Leejun previously debuted with I-REX, BGC, and New And.B. Hyojin and Yeung were pre-debut members of SUPERX, and Hyojin also trained as part of Eight. In addition, Hyojin, Yeung, and Juchan all appeared as contestants on Project 7, with Hyojin also joining Stars Awakening and Juchan having competed on Dancing High.
